about: A plain migration: one Brain Dump line, one copy in idea-mara, approved on round 0. `pointers` appends ' [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Ideas/idea-mara|idea-mara]]]' after the line's tag, one space before it, and changes nothing else. The run moves to pointed with next_check 1 (no flags file yet). b1-u1 becomes pointer-written, its pointed_lines the line as it reads now. The real Edit guard gives [].
readings: next_check is 1 when the run folder holds no flags file (CONTRACT.md 5.4 item 1).
The open run at pointed keeps batch at the last batch, round 0, fixing null, as at batches-done.
